verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents a programmable REST API covering voice, SMS, messaging, call logs and configuration. It also offers official SDKs (JavaScript, Java, .NET), app registration with auth credentials, and event subscriptions, so the product can be driven without its UI. However, nothing in the evidence addresses CI pipelines or unattended non-interactive authentication, and the scope docs describe user-confirmed authorization. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive or service-account auth for headless runs, an official CLI or CI integration guidance, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
